responsibility: Defines the OpenVMS Alpha subtarget configuration, covering object-format assumptions, VMS-specific CPP builtins, register usage and allocation order, calling-convention data structures for argument classification, frame/elimination behavior, pointer and malloc alignment rules, section and common-symbol emission, constructor/destructor and debugging conventions, PIC/jump-table policy, linker/start/endfile specs, and VMS runtime defaults. It is the ABI-heavy customization layer that adapts the generic Alpha backend to OpenVMS code generation and toolchain semantics.
